summary: Conditionally invokes SessionMenuModeSwitch after a session restart. Requires the qualifying-DSQ flag and the HUD-disable flag to be clear, the session-mode identifier to be unset (-1), and the player vehicle field at offset 16484 to equal 1; otherwise does nothing and always returns 0.

operations.description: Qualifying DSQ flag dword_7CE814 must equal 0 (feature disabled) before proceeding.
HUD-disable flag byte_7CE254 must equal 0 (HUD enabled) before proceeding.
Session-mode identifier dword_8AD298 must equal -1 (unset) before proceeding.
Player vehicle reached through pointer dword_7C54E8 must have the dword at offset 16484 equal to 1 before proceeding.
When all four guards pass, call SessionMenuModeSwitch to transition the session into post-race menu mode.
Return 0 in every path, whether or not SessionMenuModeSwitch was invoked.

unresolved: Identity and meaning of the player-vehicle field at offset 16484 is not evidenced; only the equality-to-1 check is observed.
Purpose of the exact guard combination (DSQ disabled, HUD enabled, session mode unset, player field == 1) is not explained by packet evidence.
Function name is reused from existing analysis (RestartMenuModeGuard); it is a semantic label, not recovered original source text.
